science.title: The Sun's Impossible Floating Mountains
science.description: Scientists at the Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research have produced the most detailed simulations ever of solar prominences. These vast clouds of cooler plasma suspended in the Sun's scorching outer atmosphere have often perplexed solar astronomers. Their research reveals that two separate processes work together to keep these structures alive, and could one day help us predict the violent eruptions that drive dangerous space weather here on Earth.

ai.title: Google Breaks Ground on India AI Hub in Visakhapatnam with Adani Enterprises Partnership
ai.description: Google officially broke ground on its landmark AI hub in Visakhapatnam on April 28, 2026, representing a $15 billion investment over five years (2026-2030) in partnership with AdaniConneX and Nxtra by Airtel. The ceremony was attended by key government officials including Union IT Minister Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw and Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Shri N. Chandrababu Naidu. The project includes India's first gigawatt-scale AI hub with three data center campuses designed to support the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision. Google announced comprehensive community development initiatives including workforce training for over 1,000 individuals, women entrepreneurship programs for 10,000+ participants, and maritime trade modernization efforts.
